shortDescription: According to Wallstreetcn, Russia's Defense Ministry said on the morning of September 20 that 1,110 Ukrainian fixed-wing drones were intercepted and shot down overnight over 20 locations and the Black Sea waters.

title: Russia Says 1,110 Ukrainian Fixed-Wing Drones Were Intercepted Overnight
